mdqda.description: Markdown qualitative data analysis (QDA) extension: generate Foam/Obsidian-compatible block IDs and block references for Markdown paragraphs, copy them to the clipboard or append them to a target document; the Block Reference Library sidebar manages coded snippets, the Code Manager manages codes and the Theme Manager manages themes — entities are Markdown files whose YAML frontmatter `tags` list contains `code` / `theme`.
mdqda.view.blockRefLibrary.name: Block Reference Library
mdqda.view.codeManager.name: Code Manager
mdqda.welcome.blockRefLibrary:
No block references found in the workspace Markdown files.

Use **QDA: Copy Block Reference** (`Ctrl+Alt+B`) on any Markdown paragraph and this view will list all text snippets that have a block ID. Right-click a snippet to organize it into a folder.
mdqda.welcome.codeManager:
No codes yet. A code is a .md file whose YAML frontmatter `tags` list contains `code`, with a body of block references (append with `Ctrl+Alt+B`).

Click **Define as Code** in the view title bar to mark Markdown files (or whole folders) as codes, or click + to create a new code.
mdqda.view.themeManager.name: Theme Manager
mdqda.welcome.themeManager:
No themes found. A theme is a Markdown note whose YAML frontmatter `tags` list contains `theme`.

Click **QDA: New Theme** to create one, or use **Define as Theme** in the Theme Manager view title bar to define existing notes as themes.
